description.value: El Comal Burnaby is the factory and restaurant location of a two-location Mexican food group, combining a working tortilla production facility with a sit-down restaurant and an on-site retail store selling handmade tortillas and Mexican provisions. The menu spans tacos on hand-pressed tortillas, birria specialties, burritos, and fresh seafood dishes drawing on traditional Mexican regional recipes. The attached store gives cyclists the option to pick up housemade tortillas and packaged goods to take on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Burnaby location of El Comal at 7650 Winston St, Burnaby, BC V5A 2H4, matching the OSM street address and phone number (604) 420-1327 shown on the contact page. The site explicitly advertises takeout and online ordering. No bike-specific amenities, Wi-Fi, washroom details, or water refill information appear anywhere on the website; the OSM community field incorrectly lists 'North Vancouver' when the address and website both clearly place this in Burnaby.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the business is located in Burnaby (7650 Winston St, Burnaby, BC V5A 2H4) per both the website contact page and menu pages.
OSM address field omits city and postal code; full address sourced from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Mexican restaurant with confirmed address, phone, and active website showing current menus and hours.
